name: FaqWithBg
title: FAQ on a gradient background
description: A FAQ accordion on a full-width gradient panel with plus-icon chevrons and elevated cards. Use as a bold, standalone FAQ section on a landing page.

i18nKeys.faqwithbg__q1: How can I reset my password?
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__a1: Head to your account settings and click 'Reset password'. We'll email you a secure link to choose a new one.
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__q2: Can I create more than one account?
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__a2: Yes — you can create as many accounts as you like, each with its own email address and settings.
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__q3: How can I subscribe to the monthly newsletter?
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__a3: Open your notification preferences and toggle on the monthly newsletter. You can unsubscribe at any time.
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__q4: Do you store credit card information securely?
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__a4: We never store raw card numbers. Payments are handled by a PCI-compliant processor and only a token is kept on our side.
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__q5: What payment systems do you work with?
i18nKeys.faqwithbg__a5: We accept all major credit cards, and support Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers in most regions.
